# 台華線頂對照典 — source for Han alternatives

Foundation: Tēⁿ Liông-úi / 鄭良偉. Additions and editing: Iûⁿ Ún-giân / 楊允言
and transcription/proofreading volunteers. Digitized and normalized POJ fields
are distributed by ChhoeTaigi/ChhoeTaigiDatabase, existing pinned revision
b33c6a1fcc2d11a2962e76b6055d528d11677c3b. Attribution and permission are documented
in ../itaigi/README.md, section #1 (2002+ 台華線頂對照典).

License: CC BY-SA 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ .
The source is provided unchanged in taihoa.csv; original URL, SHA-256, size and
record count are in source.json. Derived pairs retain source IDs and are shared
under the same terms. Changes: exact whole-reading selection against already
shipped POJ outputs, NFC normalization, all-Han validation, familiarity/basic
vocabulary eligibility and deterministic canonical example choice.

No Mandarin gloss is used as a Han spelling. No new phonetic words or aliases are
imported. Alternative-reading fields are not paired speculatively. A dictionary
is not a usage-frequency corpus or proof of community spelling agreement.
